description: This PHP source file defines the 'Reminder_Invitee' class, which manages reminder invitees within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for saving, loading, and deleting invitee data related to reminders, along with utility functions for retrieving invitee names from various modules.

classes.name: Reminder_Invitee
classes.description: Represents an invitee associated with a reminder, providing static methods to save, load, and delete associated data within the reminders system.

methods.name: saveRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Saves multiple invitees' data for a specific reminder, handling new and existing invitees appropriately.

methods.name: loadRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Loads invitees data associated with a specific reminder ID, optionally duplicating data for new entries.

methods.name: deleteRemindersInviteesMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple invitees associated with a reminder, excluding specified invitee IDs if provided.
